claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Iocetamic acid is an iodinated oral cholecystographic contrast agent with no known antiproliferative mechanism; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines, with any rare effects attributable to idiosyncratic iodine-related hypersensitivity rather than a shared cytotoxic class effect.
